note: Shadow's resources in character/shadow.one on the Shadow the Hedgehog disc (read once at startup by Loading::loadPlayerKeys; a missing or wrong file stops the game). Entry names of the archive; the animation names are ours, the names Scripts/shadow/player.lua uses.

model.name: SHADOW_BODY.DFF
model.note: The parts are named so that the mesh is built from them and Entity::switchMeshPart can swap one for another; a part without a .BON of its own names the bone of the main skeleton to attach to ('bone').

idle.note: 'sh_idle' of SHADOW.MTP for the SH.BON skeleton (observed: 100 frames).
The hands' fingers, for LTE.BON / RTE.BON (observed: 100 frames, the first node is the wrist sh_j_l1te / sh_j_r1te).

animationsNote: The motions the player script picks, for SH.BON. Which motion the game plays in which state is not decoded: the names of SHADOW.MTP's table (158 entries) are the only evidence (hypothesis): sh_walk, sh_run, sh_jump_a, sh_jump_b, sh_jump_c (a jump: observed on the disc, each one's last pose is the next one's first, and sh_jump_c turns the root by -6.98 radians, a full somersault curled up; then sh_jump_idle, whose first pose is close to sh_jump_c's last), sh_break_a (a brake), sh_dam_m_a (damage). 'loop' false: the motion plays once and holds its last frame ('jump' and 'jumpB': sh_jump_a is a start motion, observed by the user; b follows it).

jumpC.note: The somersault, which ends in the pose it starts from, so it loops.

dash.note: The jump dash's motion (observed in the live log: animation index 6, motion number 83 = sh_fw_jump, range 0 to 15, looping while the dash lasts).
